title: A travel planner held a flight after a hotel hold in the same batch was refused
summary: A recorded run of the bundled travel planner a15 held a flight and then called hold_booking for a hotel at a price that did not match a search result. The tool refused the hotel hold, and T1-009 reports a partial batch on hold_booking. A recorded run of the same task that keeps that guard and does not leave a flight hold when the hotel hold is refused passes the same check.

target.description: The bundled travel planner a15, case 0, judged from its recorded OpenTelemetry trace (Failure Lab 005).
target.version: the a15 traces that ship with agentest-ai 3.8.0 and this repository
target.scope_note: A teaching example about one recorded run. It is not a claim about how often agents fail, and it is not a verdict on a framework or a model.

reproduce.judge: agentest std run --otlp examples/failure-lab/005-partial-booking-batch/traces/original.otlp.jsonl --card agents/a15/agent-card.json --tools agents/a15/tools.json --ids T1-009
